name: private_key_recognizer
note: Private key material: PEM/OpenSSH/PGP '-----BEGIN … PRIVATE KEY-----' blocks, SSH2 encrypted keys and PuTTY .ppk files. Source: detect-secrets (Apache-2.0) detect_secrets/plugins/private_key.py, which only looks for the header lines; for redaction the block patterns cover header to footer so the key body is removed. The header-only pattern (lower score) still flags truncated keys and is dropped when a full block matches. 'ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY' (PKCS#8) and PuTTY v3 are additions.

patterns.name: ssh2_encrypted_private_key_block
patterns.regex: ---- BEGIN SSH2 ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY ----[\s\S]*?---- END SSH2 ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY ----
